author: daall

**Description**
When we run the bgp_allow_list.TestBGPAllowListDeny tests we see failures due to routes being advertised to neighbors that should not be present when the allow list is empty and the default action is drop.
<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Run bgp.test_bgp_allow_list.TestBGPAllowListDeny.test_empty_allow_list_deny against a DUT running the master image

**Describe the results you received:**
```
Failed: Unexpected routes on neighbors, failed_results={   "ARISTA03T2": [     {       "reasons": [         "When default_action=\"deny\" and allow list is empty, all routes should be dropped. route=172.16.30.0/24, node=ARISTA03T2"...
```

**Describe the results you expected:**
Test should pass/routes should not be advertised.

linkedPullRequests.title: Update BGP Allow List test case
linkedPullRequests.author: abdosi
linkedPullRequests.body:
Fix https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/6572

What/Why I did:

- Updated test case to align with https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/6370 which made allow list action dynamic
- Added test case to cover https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/pull/6671
- Remove fixed value of Drop Community and read from /etc/sonic/constants.yml file.
- Organized the case as  three test case one to verify default pre/post-config behavior when no prefix list there on device and 
   then test case to verify with prefix list programmed with action as permit and deny 

How I verify:

201911 image is passing with this change.

`adosi@624e49377782:/var/src/Networking-acs-sonic-mgmt/tests$ py.test --inventory "../ansible/str,../ansible/veos" --host-pattern str-xxxx-on-2 --module-path "../ansible/library/" --testbed vms13-5-t1-lag  --testbed_file "../ansible/testbed.csv" --log-cli-level info   -ra -vvv "bgp/test_bgp_allow_list.py" --skip_sanity
`
